intent: Diagnose and restore Android first-frame delivery after PC Viewer connection and screen-share approval; do not equate capture initialization with a working remote connection.
rollback: Revert only the RemoteSessionController diagnostic changes and its new diagnostic test; retain the previously released JNI keep rules.

requestReview.reason: This change only records existing WebRTC and Firestore completion callbacks in local logcat. It adds no requests, listeners, timers, uploads, or retries. Existing TURN provisioning remains an unresolved external dependency.
requestReview.assumptions: No request lifecycle changes are included.

outcomes.acceptance: After approval, PC Viewer displays the Android screen on initial and repeated connections, including separate networks requiring relay.

Firebase Hosting returns 0.1.85 for all three Android apps and HTTP 200 for agent.zip, viewer.zip and control-addon.zip. SDP failure diagnostics distinguish remote offer, answer creation and local answer without exposing SDP. Physical log 20260906-055742 shows capture initialization without first-frame evidence and getRtcConfiguration NOT_FOUND. First-frame acceptance remains incomplete.
outcomes.physicalGap: A reachable authenticated TURN service and affected Android/PC devices are required to verify separate-network first frame, disconnect and repeat connection. Do not release this as a completed screen fix.

outcomes.acceptance: PC Viewer Connect while Android Agent is in background does not terminate the Agent; consent and approved first-frame delivery remain available.
